name: MonarchSlotPicker
title: SlotPicker
wrapsNative: MonarchMiniMonth and androidx.compose.material3.FilterChip times in an androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow, with MonarchSkeleton, MonarchBanner and MonarchTimezoneSelect
summary: Pick a day on a month calendar, then one of that day's open times, shown in the visitor's time zone with an optional zone picker.
whenToUse: For the booking step of an appointment, meeting or interview, choosing from times the server computed, and for rescheduling to another open time.
whenNotToUse: To pick any date and time use the Material 3 DatePicker and TimePicker (the date-time-picker entry); to compare many people's calendars use MonarchTimeGrid.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSlotPicker(slots: List<MonarchSlotPickerSlot>, selection: Long?, onSelectionChange: (Long?) -> Unit, day: Long?, onDayChange: (Long) -> Unit, timeZone: String, previousMonthIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, nextMonthIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, allowDeselect: Boolean = false, visibleMonth: Long? = null, onVisibleMonthChange: ((Long) -> Unit)? = null, availableDays: Set<Long>? = null, isDayDisabled: ((Long) -> Boolean)? = null, minimumDate: Long? = null, maximumDate: Long? = null, today: Long? = null, firstDayOfWeek: Int? = null, is24Hour: Boolean? = null, onTimeZoneChange: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, pinnedTimeZones: List<String> = emptyList(), businessTimeZone: String? = null, loading: Boolean = false, error: String? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onChooseOutside: (() -> Unit)? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchSlotPickerLabels = MonarchSlotPickerLabels())
data class MonarchSlotPickerSlot(start: Long, end: Long? = null, seatsLeft: Int? = null, enabled: Boolean = true)

class MonarchSlotPickerLabels(chooseDay: String? = null, empty: String? = null, loading: String? = null, loaded: ((count: Int, day: String) -> String)? = null, times: ((day: String) -> String)? = null, seatsLeft: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, timeZone: String? = null, shownIn: ((zone: String) -> String)? = null, convertedFrom: ((zone: String) -> String)? = null, notOpen: ((time: String) -> String)? = null, chooseOutside: String? = null, retry: String? = null, miniMonth: MonarchMiniMonthLabels = MonarchMiniMonthLabels(), timezoneSelect: MonarchTimezoneSelectLabels = MonarchTimezoneSelectLabels())

options.name: slots
options.description: The times of the chosen day, in display order; the app loads them.

options.name: selection / onSelectionChange
options.description: The chosen slot's start instant, and the callback with the new one (null when cleared).

options.name: day / onDayChange
options.description: The day whose times are shown, as its UTC midnight, and the callback when the person picks a day.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: The IANA id of the zone the times are shown in.

options.name: previousMonthIcon / nextMonthIcon
options.description: The icons of the calendar's month buttons; Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: allowDeselect
options.description: A second press on the chosen time clears it.

options.name: visibleMonth / onVisibleMonthChange
options.description: The month on screen and the callback when it changes, for example to load bookable days.

options.name: availableDays
options.description: The bookable days; every other day is disabled.

options.name: isDayDisabled
options.description: Disables more days, for example full ones.

options.name: minimumDate / maximumDate
options.description: The booking window.

options.name: today
options.description: Today for the calendar's marker; null is the device's today.

options.name: firstDayOfWeek
options.description: Calendar.SUNDAY to Calendar.SATURDAY; null follows the locale.

options.name: is24Hour
options.description: A 24-hour clock; null follows the device setting.

options.name: onTimeZoneChange
options.description: Shows a MonarchTimezoneSelect; without it the zone is a line of text.

options.name: pinnedTimeZones
options.description: Zones listed first in the picker.

options.name: businessTimeZone
options.description: The zone the business works in; a note says times are converted when it differs.

options.name: loading
options.description: Placeholders instead of the times; announced.

options.name: error / onRetry
options.description: A danger banner instead of the times, with a retry button.

options.name: onChooseOutside
options.description: A way out when no time fits, in the empty state and in the not-open warning.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether days and times can be chosen.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the calendar's and the zone picker's.

states.name: no day
states.description: "Choose a day to see available times." under the calendar.

states.name: times
states.description: The day's title and its times as filter chips; the chosen one is selected, taken times are disabled, limited places show "3 left".

states.name: loading
states.description: Six placeholders, hidden from TalkBack, and "Loading available times" announced.

states.name: empty
states.description: "No times are available on this day. Try another day." and the Choose another time button when onChooseOutside is given.

states.name: error
states.description: A danger MonarchBanner with the message and Try again.

states.name: not open
states.description: A warning MonarchBanner when the selection is on the day but is none of its times.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Days and times cannot be chosen.

appearance: The calendar of MonarchMiniMonth, a strong day title, times as Material 3 filter chips in the Monarch theme (the chosen time filled), muted hints and zone notes, and banners in the danger and warning tones. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web places the month beside the times on wide containers; on Android the parts stack, which is the phone pattern, and the picker grows with its content, so put it in a scrolling screen. Days are UTC-midnight epoch milliseconds as in Material 3 DatePickerState and slot starts are epoch milliseconds, where the web uses ISO strings; the zone stays an IANA id string, as in MonarchTimezoneSelect. Times are one TalkBack element each instead of the web's single tab stop with arrow keys; the hour cycle follows is24Hour or the device setting instead of the web's hourCycle. The web's headingLevel, uncontrolled defaults (defaultValue, defaultDay, defaultMonth) and locale prop are not offered: state is hoisted and the locale comes from the configuration. The error is a String instead of a node. iOS has no entry yet.
accessibility: The day's title is a heading.
The times are a selectable group named "Available times on Wednesday, November 4"; the chosen time is selected and taken times are disabled.
Each time is a Material 3 filter chip with a 48dp touch target.
Loading and the number of open times ("2 times on Wednesday, November 4") are announced through a polite live region that is always present.
Days outside availableDays are disabled in the calendar and read with their full date.
The zone is always visible, as text or as a labelled picker, so the times are never ambiguous.
Times and the day title wrap at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: The selection is not cleared when the day changes; clear it in onDayChange if the product wants that.
A selection on the chosen day that is not among the slots shows the not-open warning; a selection on another day shows nothing.
Slot starts are shown in timeZone, so a 09:00 UTC slot reads 4:00 AM in New York in November.
With an unknown zone id the times are shown in UTC.

examples.title: Booking with a time zone picker
examples.webExample: Booking with a time zone picker
examples.template:
CompositionLocalProvider(LocalConfiguration provides locale) {
    Column(Modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
        MonarchSlotPicker(
            slots = slots,
            selection = selection,
            onSelectionChange = { selection = it },
            day = day,
            onDayChange = {
                day = it
                selection = null
            },
            timeZone = zone,
            previousMonthIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronLeft, contentDescription = null) },
            nextMonthIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
            availableDays = setOf({{availableDays.0|millis}}, {{availableDays.1|millis}}, {{availableDays.2|millis}}, {{availableDays.3|millis}}, {{availableDays.4|millis}}, {{availableDays.5|millis}}),
            minimumDate = {{min|millis}},
            maximumDate = {{max|millis}},
            today = {{today|millis}},
            firstDayOfWeek = Calendar.MONDAY,
            is24Hour = true,
            onTimeZoneChange = { zone = it },
            pinnedTimeZones = listOf({{pinnedTimeZones.0}}, {{pinnedTimeZones.1}}, {{pinnedTimeZones.2}}),
            businessTimeZone = {{businessTimeZone}},
        )
        MonarchText(
            text = "Selected: " + (selection?.let { java.text.SimpleDateFormat("EEE d MMM, HH:mm", Locale.UK).apply { timeZone = java.util.TimeZone.getTimeZone(zone) }.format(it) } ?: "none"),
            style = MonarchTextStyle.Caption,
        )
    }
}

parityExceptions.reason: The web label of this button joins its visible text and hidden text with no separator; on Android the button is named with a sentence for TalkBack and its visible text is shown as it is.
parityExceptions.convention: a control is named in a sentence, not by concatenated visible text (Material accessibility)
